Definition: Chariph, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hariph is named twice, once among the returning exiles, whose children numbered a hundred and twelve, and once among those who sealed the covenant. Nehemiah counts his children in the return, and then records his name on the sealed covenant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two mentions are a small testimony: a family that came back, and then signed its name to the covenant.
